svg.title: Carrier top view
svg.text: Step: motor pigtails and the power-in pigtail (zip-tie for strain relief)
antenna: keep it off the board
2 × USB-C at this end: plug the ESP32 power bank into the COM port
(the one you flash and log through)
power-in plug (3-pin): from the motor power bank
zip-tie the pigtails through free holes for strain relief
